questions.stem: A 6-year-old boy is brought to the OPD by his mother. She noticed her son has recurrent episodes of giving a blank look while playing ball games. No history is suggestive of any development delay in the child. No history of loss of consciousness and the child resumes play soon after within a few seconds. EEG performed on the child shows a characteristic 3Hz spike and waveform. The most appropriate treatment, in this case, would be?
